scripts.typecheck: fail=0; for p in packages/* apps/*; do [ -f "$p/tsconfig.json" ] || continue; echo "== $p"; node_modules/.bin/tsc -p "$p" --noEmit || fail=1; done; exit $fail
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/review build && bun run --cwd apps/workspace build
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run --cwd packages/review check
